name: squatch-stack
description: Plugins from Squatch Stack for Claude Code and Codex: the Squatch Stack shop and Petnecto adoptable shelter pets. Both connect to servers we run and install no local code. The shop can send the studio a request, only after you confirm it.

plugins.name: squatch-shop
plugins.description: Browse the Squatch Stack shop, find a gift, and get a checkout link to pay in your own browser. Never pays for you.

plugins.name: petnecto
plugins.description: Find adoptable shelter pets with Petnecto and get the shelter's contact details. Read-only, no sign-in.
